title: Business Intelligence Specialist
description:
We are seeking a Insights \& Analytics Lead (Business Intelligence) for a Series A funded Wellness Brand.
 



  





**Job Profile** 




 Your work will typically move through: Business Question \> Data \> Analysis \> Insight \> Decision \> Outcome.
 



 Knowing the difference between Fact, Inference, Hypothesis, and Unknown will be an important part of the job.
 



 Solve ambiguous business problems.\*\* Take loosely defined questions and structure them into analytical problems that can actually be investigated.
 



 Diagnose performance. Identify the underlying drivers behind important business movements rather than simply reporting the movement.
 



 Generate insights. Find patterns, relationships, exceptions, and opportunities that are not obvious from standard reporting.
 



 Challenge assumptions. Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



 Create a common fact base. Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



 Translate analysis into business language. Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.
 



 Support important decisions. As you build context and credibility, increasingly contribute to recommendations, experiments, and decision\-making.
 



 Build analytical systems. Develop reusable frameworks and diagnostic approaches so the organisation becomes progressively less dependent on individual intuition.
 



  





**Requirements:** 




 Any Post Graduate
 



 5\-10 Years of experience
 



 Must have proven experience solving unusually difficult analytical problems
 



 You could come from Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Strategy, Consulting, Business Intelligence, Growth, Product, Marketing Analytics, Operations, Revenue Management, Corporate Strategy, Finance, Founder or Chief of Staff roles, or other analytically intensive functions.
 



 You could have worked in Consumer, Technology, SaaS, E\-commerce, Q\-commerce, Fintech, Edtech, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Consulting, or something completely different.
 



 Industry experience is not a prerequisite. If you are a strong analytical thinker, we expect you to learn a new business.
 



 What we need:
 



 Analytical reasoning\- You can take a messy problem, break it down, and determine what needs to be understood.
 



 Data fluency\- You are comfortable working directly with data and can independently investigate a problem using tools such as Excel/Sheets, SQL, BI tools, or equivalent. You do not need to be a data engineer. You do need to be able to go behind a dashboard when the question requires it.
 



 Business judgment\- You understand that analysis is valuable only when it improves understanding or decisions. You naturally ask: “So what?”
 



 Intellectual independence\- You are willing to challenge an attractive explanation when the evidence does not support it.
 



 Intellectual honesty\- You are comfortable saying “I don’t know yet” and equally comfortable saying “I was wrong.”
 



 Communication\- You can take something complicated and explain it simply.
 



 What This Role Is NOT
 



 This is not primarily a MIS role, reporting role, dashboard\-building role, Tableau administration role, data engineering role, or data\-entry role. We are not looking for someone whose main contribution is producing more reports.
 



 You should be comfortable with analytical tools such as Excel/Google Sheets, SQL or equivalent, and Tableau/Power BI/Looker or similar BI platforms. Python, statistics, and experimentation capabilities are useful additions.

title: Senior Manager — Industry Domain (Credit Decisioning)
description:
Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections operations. Our AI\-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000\+ users across 70\+ global financial enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.
 



  





**Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo** 




  





 Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain expertise with cutting\-edge technology. Our platform's human\-centric design, coupled with enterprise\-grade scalability and AI\-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while ensuring high user adoption and engagement.
 



  





**Recognition \& Trust** 




  





 ● Backed by $45M\+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and Bertelsmann Investments.
 



 ● Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life, HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!
 



 ● Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced Functionality ranking.
 



 ● Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a
 



 "Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.
 



 ● Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence
 



  





**The Role** 




  





 Credit decisions at scale — whether a loan gets approved, at what rate, under what conditions — are governed by business rule engines and decision frameworks that have been refined over decades inside banks, NBFCs, and risk analytics firms. Vymo's agentic AI systems interact with, augment, and in some cases replace components of these decisioning frameworks.
 



  





 Building the right system requires someone who understands how business rule engines actually work: how rules are authored, versioned, tested, and deployed; how credit policy translates into decision logic; where the standard engines fall short and where manual override is still the norm. That is this role.
 



  





 You are the person who sits between a client's risk team and Vymo's product team — making sure that what is being built reflects how credit decisioning actually works in a regulated Indian financial institution, not how a software team imagines it works. You will carry domain knowledge from the BRE layer through to the underwriting policy and credit risk framework that sits above it.
 



  





***The crux of this role: you know enough about credit decisioning and BRE architecture to know which questions, asked in which sequence, reveal how a client's decision engine actually works — and what Vymo needs to build to sit alongside it or replace it.***




  





**What You Will Do** 




  





**1\. Client Discovery — Decode the Decision Engine** 



* Diagnose architectural realities and data flows by asking targeted questions that reveal system dependencies, latencies, and integration requirements.
* Translate discovered logic gaps into actionable visual maps and precise engineering specifications for the product team.



**2\. Product Requirements — Translate Decisioning Logic Into What to Build** 



* Translate credit decisioning and Business Rule Engine (BRE) logic into precise product specifications for Vymo's agentic layer, defining routing, rule execution, and human\-in\-the\-loop interventions.
* Validate technical assumptions against BFSI deployment cycles while mapping major BRE platforms (e.g., SAS, Experian, FICO) to ensure architectural accuracy.



**3\. GTM Support — Lend Credibility to the Technical Sales Conversation** 



* Partner with sales teams in high\-stakes sessions to provide deep architectural credibility and handle advanced technical inquiries regarding BRE and decisioning systems.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client architects and risk heads, auditing technical proposals and developing GTM assets that address platform constraints and regulatory governance.



**4\. Industry Intelligence — Track How Decisioning Is Evolving** 



* Track RBI regulatory changes—including the Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF) and AI explainability rules—alongside Indian BRE market trends to anticipate compliance demands.
* Build a strong network of industry experts to validate core architecture choices and feed real\-world market insights directly into the product roadmap.



  





**What You will Bring** 




  





**Experience \& Fluency** 




  




* **Domain Background:** 
 Operational depth in credit decisioning across key sectors—whether coming from BRE vendors (SAS, FICO, Experian), bank/NBFC credit risk teams, underwriting operations, risk consulting, or credit bureaus.
* **BRE \& Risk Architecture:** 
 Deep understanding of Business Rule Engine (BRE) architectures, rule authoring, champion\-challenger frameworks, scorecard calibration, and baseline risk concepts ($PD/LGD/EAD$).
* **Origination \& Integration Landscape: Practical knowledge of Loan Origination System (LOS) integration patterns, core platform configurations (e.g., PowerCurve, Blaze Advisor), and performance metrics like Straight Through Processing (STP) rates.**
* **Regulatory \& Compliance Context:** 
 Familiarity with RBI guidelines regarding algorithmic credit decisions, model risk management, explainability requirements, and cloud data localisation constraints.



  





**Mindset \& Core Traits** 




  




* **Architectural Inquiry:** 
 Driven by deep curiosity about how entire systems fit together, possessing the precise sequence of targeted questions that uncover how a client’s engine
 *actually* 
 operates beneath the documentation.
* **Skeptical Practitioner:** 
 Operates with a healthy skepticism of stated architectures; validates system realities by analyzing deployment logs, rule histories, and exception reports rather than relying solely on official diagrams.
* **Policy\-to\-Logic Translation:** 
 Seamlessly bridges the gap between high\-level credit policy language and structured, actionable rule engine engineering specifications.
* **Grounded Intellectual Humility:** 
 Explicitly understands the boundaries of personal technical knowledge, prioritizing accurate discovery and domain\-expert networking over making unverified assumptions.

 Challenge assumptions. Test prevailing explanations rather than accepting the first plausible narrative, including your own.
 



 Create a common fact base. Help leadership distinguish between what we know, what we believe, and what we still need to find out.
 



 Translate analysis into business language. Turn complex analysis into concise conclusions that senior leaders can understand and act upon.

 Any Post Graduate

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You On This Role**
 The Senior Supply Chain Improvement Specialist supports business growth, service enhancements and cost\-to\-serve productivity by identifying, designing and implementing supply chain and E2E value chain improvements. The role may focus deeply on a specific supply chain sub\-function or span multiple functions across the E2E value chain, depending on business priorities. This role delivers measurable business value through structured improvement methodologies, strong analytics and effective cross‑functional collaboration at local, regional and global levels.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**E2E Supply Chain Design and Optimization**
* Design, optimize and test supply chain and E2E network scenarios using analytical and optimization tools (e.g. OMP, spreadsheet analysis, simulation modeling).Drive adoption of ERP and internal supply planning platforms like OMP, DOC, MEIO etc.
* Own model assumptions, constraints and business rules \- ensure alignment with commercial, operational and financial objectives.
* Identify and balance trade\-offs across inventory, sourcing, production, logistics, service levels, capital investment and asset utilization.
* Support or lead supply chain infrastructure design and optimization (distribution networks, warehouses, plants, outsourcing models, logistics assets such as tanks and warehouses).


**Cost\-to\-Serve, Productivity \& Value Creation**
* Identify, lead and deliver cost\-to\-serve, productivity and service improvement initiatives across the E2E value chain.
* Drive measurable improvements in supply chain costs, cash flow, asset utilization, productivity, quality and customer service.
* Take ownership of improvement initiatives from problem definition through implementation and value realization.


**Analytics, Metrics \& Storytelling**
* Deep dive into assigned supply chain disciplines to build strong conceptual, process and data understanding.
* Develop, analyze and track meaningful metrics and KPIs to support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Use analytical techniques to generate insights and recommendations.
* Translate complex analyses into clear, compelling business storytelling to influence cross‑functional stakeholders and drive prioritization.


**Ways of Working \& Collaboration**
* Collaborate closely with business teams, regional/global partners and other E2E Improvement Specialists to ensure alignment and leverage synergies.
* Provide informal guidance and coaching to junior team members and interns.
* Interact with Quality, SMEs and customer\-facing teams to address service gaps, complaints and customer requirements.


**Qualifications**
* 3–8 years of experience in Supply Chain, Operations or related process improvement roles.
* University degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* APICS and/or Six Sigma certification preferred.
* Experience with SAP and familiarity with analytics/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Python) preferred.


**Your Skills**
* Supply chain network optimization and E2E process understanding
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving and modeling skills
* Project and change management capability
* Ability to influence without authority and collaborate across functions and regions
* Customer\-centric mindset with a focus on value creation
* Strong communication and data storytelling skills
* Appetite for digital enablement and productivity improvements


**Additional Notes**
* Role may require flexibility to work across different time zones.
* Scope may evolve based on organizational priorities and project allocation.
* Relocation or visa sponsorship is not aligned with this role


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals.
+ Employee stock purchase programs (availability varies depending on location).

* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match Program (U.S. only).
+ Dow will take the value of monthly student debt payments and apply them as if they are contributions to the Employees’ Savings Plan (401(k)), helping employees reach the Company match.

* Robust medical and life insurance packages that offer a variety of coverage options to meet your individual needs. Travel insurance is also available in certain countries/locations.
* Opportunities to learn and grow through training and mentoring, work experiences, community involvement and team building.
* Workplace culture empowering role\-based flexibility to maximize personal productivity and balance personal needs.
* Competitive yearly vacation allowance.
* Paid time off for new parents (birthing and non\-birthing, including adoptive and foster parents).
* Paid time off to care for family members who are sick or injured.
* Paid time off to support volunteering and Employee Resource Group’s (ERG) participation.
* Wellbeing Portal for all Dow employees, our one\-stop shop to promote wellbeing, empowering employees to take ownership of their entire wellbeing journey.
* On\-site fitness facilities to help stay healthy and active (availability varies depending on location).
* Employee discounts for online shopping, cinema tickets, gym memberships and more.
* Additionally, some of our locations might offer:
+ Transportation allowance (availability varies depending on location)
+ Meal subsidiaries/vouchers (availability varies depending on location)
+ Carbon\-neutral transportation incentives e.g. bike to work (availability varies depending on location)


 Join our team, we can make a difference together.
   

  

**About Dow Chemical International Pvt Ltd**
 Dow Chemical International Private Limited (Dow India) aims to be the most innovative, sustainable, inclusive customer\-centric materials science company. The company is committed to delivering the right solutions to its customers’ challenges. With broadest technology sets spanning performance materials, industrial intermediates, and plastics Dow India delivers differentiated science\-based products and solutions in high\-growth segments, such as packaging, infrastructure, automobile, and consumer care.
   

  

 A Great Place to Work® Certified company with approximately over 1000 employees, its operations comprise of manufacturing sites, innovation center, established centers of excellence, and commercial office. As a responsible corporate, the company supports its Corporate Social Responsibility (program) with technology expertise and employee volunteerism. Dow India works with non\-profit partners towards the empowerment of differently abled, women, and children in communities where it operates. The company aims to redefine the societal blueprint, by supporting holistic sustainability and circular economy initiatives.
   

  

 As part of our dedication to inclusion, Dow is committed to equal opportunities in employment. We encourage every employee to bring their whole self to work each day to not only deliver more value, but also have a more fulfilling career. Further information regarding Dow's equal opportunities is available on www.dow.com.
